limits: Six serialized HTTP/SSE requests in one persistent source-built API worker, starting immediately after readiness; no request warmup or cached translations. Each request emits 64 tokens and commits 63 state transitions. Decode and SSE inter-token rates exclude startup/prefill; startup is reported separately. CPU/GPU power limits, OS paging and background apps are uncontrolled; the rate is not a guarantee under sustained thermal throttling. Accuracy is a separate full-vector comparison of 16 cases/224 vectors, including EOS, length limits, cancellation and a 2119-token sliding-KV prompt. FP32 summation order differs from ordinary decoding. This is not a general translation-quality benchmark.
